text:
nina_sales: TidalWave Analytics asked for our SOC2/ISO excerpts + a signed external-scan attestation. They also want single-region EU log residency and an estimate for Dedicated EU with customer KMS. Deadline: 2 business days.
sam_se: Copy. Do we have a short redacted package for presales and a signable scan attestation?
rae_security: Yes. I can provide SOC2 summary (redacted) and sign the external-scan attestation we use for POCs. If they request warranty language or alternate signatories route to legal.
ina_sales: They also asked whether we can push logs to their EU SIEM during the POC. Any ops constraints?
oliver_ops: We can forward logs to a customer EU SIEM from a Dedicated EU pool. That increases network egress and may add €150/month depending on volume. KMS in eu-central-1 is supported; provisioning ~48 hours.
sam_se: Pricing sketch for quote please, need a one-line to include in the procurement packet.
oliver_ops: Ballpark: `dedicated-eu-small: €7,500/mo`, `kms-key: €200/mo`, `one-time-provision: €2,000`. 3-month commit reduces one-time by 50%. Add egress estimate separately.
rae_security: For POC procurement, an external blackbox scan + signed attestation is typically sufficient. I'll add a note: production may require a fuller assessment.
ina_sales: Customer contact: security@tidalwave.ai (Marin Holt). They asked for network diagrams? They said not necessary for initial handoff.
rae_security: We never share internal diagrams without an NDA. If they ask later, route to legal@redwood.com and we'll gate via an NDA + presigned S3.
legal-bot: files uploaded: https://files.redwood.internal/compliance/SOC2_excerpt_TidalWave_redacted.pdf (expires in 5 days); https://files.redwood.internal/compliance/external_scan_attestation_TidalWave.docx (expires in 5 days).
nina_sales: I'll send the links and the Dedicated line items. If they accept a 3mo commit I'll ask ops to apply the setup discount. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
